question: Which two great footballers, who were members of the gold medal winning team of 1962 Asian Games, passed away in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chuni Goswami and PK Banerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Subimal** (**Chuni**) **Goswami captained India **to **Asian Games gold** in **1962**.

 
 
• He **passed away **in **April 2020**.
 
• He played for the celebrated club.
 
• He played a prime role in seeing India do well in prominent international events like Asian Cup and Merdeka Cup.
 
 
 
• **Pradip Kumar Banerjee** was an Indian professional footballer who played as a **striker **for the Indian national football team.
 
 
• **PK Banerjee** played in** Eastern Railways** throughout his career but played for Mohun Bagan on loan during a foreign tour.
 
• He represented India in three Asian Games namely, the 1958 Asian Games in Tokyo, the 1962 Asian Games in Jakarta
